source:
You are an Interrobot, a robotic companion to the police in the dangerous futuristic city of Chauso. Your job is to interrogate suspects, cut through lies, and uncover the truth.

[From [url=https://dflimbingo.itch.io/viola-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
